note: Codex approval dialogs: numbered options with a letter shortcut in parentheses; the letter selects, Esc cancels. The prompt hash covers the dialog block: up to `above` lines over the question (cut at `blockStart` when set) through the last option.

prompts.question: ^\s*[│|]?\s*((?:Would you like to|Allow|Do you want to) .{2,200}\?)
